objectives.en: Describe the life cycle of a moss

narration.en: On a wet compound wall in the monsoon, a soft green carpet appears. These mosses live on land but still need water to reproduce.
narration.kn: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ತೇವದ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೃದುವಾದ ಹಸಿರು ಹಾಸು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಪಾಚಿಗಳು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬದುಕಿದರೂ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿಗೆ ನೀರು ಬೇಕು.

body.en: Bryophytes grow in damp, shaded places and are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom because they live on soil but need water for sexual reproduction. They have no true roots, stems or leaves and are attached by rhizoids. The main plant body is the haploid gametophyte, which bears antheridia (making biflagellate antherozoids) and flask-shaped archegonia (each with one egg).
body.kn: ಬ್ರಯೋಫೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬದುಕಿದರೂ ಲೈಂಗಿಕ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿಗೆ ನೀರು ಬೇಕು; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಸ್ಯ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಉಭಯಜೀವಿಗಳು. ಮುಖ್ಯ ದೇಹ ಏಕಗುಣಿತ ಗ್ಯಾಮಿಟೋಫೈಟ್; ರೈಜಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: In a moss the main plant is the haploid gametophyte.
It makes antherozoids and eggs; the antherozoid must swim in water to reach the egg.
The zygote grows into a sporophyte of foot, seta and capsule.
Meiosis in the capsule makes haploid spores; in mosses each spore grows into a protonema, then the leafy plant.
The sporophyte stays attached to the gametophyte and depends on it for food.

title.en: The life cycle of a moss

narration.en: Mosses alternate between a gametophyte and a sporophyte. Put the stages in order.

prompt.en: Arrange the life cycle of a moss starting from the spore.
prompt.kn: ಬೀಜಕದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ ಹಾವಸೆಯ ಜೀವನ ಚಕ್ರವನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ.

steps.en: Protonema: a creeping, green, branched filament
Leafy stage: upright shoots with spirally arranged leaves and rhizoids
Antheridia and archegonia form at the tips of leafy shoots
Sperms swim through water to the egg; a diploid zygote forms
The sporophyte (foot, seta, capsule) grows on the gametophyte
Meiosis in the capsule produces haploid spores

explanation.en: In bryophytes the main plant body is the haploid gametophyte. The sporophyte is not free-living: it stays attached to the gametophyte and draws food from it.

body.en: The zygote grows into a sporophyte of foot, seta and capsule that stays attached to the gametophyte and depends on it for food. Meiosis in the capsule gives haploid spores. Sphagnum provides peat, used as fuel and as packing material because it holds water. Mosses and lichens are among the first organisms to colonise rocks and help prevent soil erosion.
body.kn: ಯುಗ್ಮಜ ಪಾದ, ಸೀಟಾ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಯಾಪ್ಸೂಲ್ ಇರುವ ಸ್ಪೊರೊಫೈಟ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದು ಗ್ಯಾಮಿಟೋಫೈಟ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ. ಸ್ಫ್ಯಾಗ್ನಮ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪೀಟ್ ದೊರೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Liverworts like Marchantia have a flat thallus and reproduce asexually by green buds called gemmae, formed in gemma cups. In mosses, the spore first grows into a creeping, green, branched filament called the protonema, which gives rise to the leafy stage bearing the sex organs. Examples of mosses: Funaria, Polytrichum, Sphagnum.
body.kn: ಮಾರ್ಕೇನ್ಷಿಯಾದಂತಹ ಲಿವರ್‌ವರ್ಟ್‌ಗಳು ಜೆಮ್ಮಾ ಕಪ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಜೆಮ್ಮೆಗಳಿಂದ ಅಲೈಂಗಿಕವಾಗಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ. ಪಾಚಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬೀಜಕವು ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರೋಟೋನೀಮಾ ಆಗಿ ನಂತರ ಎಲೆಯಂತಹ ಹಂತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Meiosis halves the chromosome number. In the moss capsule, diploid spore mother cells divide by meiosis to give haploid spores.
caption.kn: ಅರೆವಿಭಜನೆ ವರ್ಣತಂತು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಅರ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪಾಚಿಯ ಸಂಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಗುಣಿತ ಬೀಜಕ ಮಾತೃಕೋಶಗಳು ಅರೆವಿಭಜನೆಯಿಂದ ವಿಭಜಿಸಿ ಏಕಗುಣಿತ ಬೀಜಕಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

problem.en: In a moss, state whether each of these is haploid (n) or diploid (2n): protonema, antherozoid, zygote, capsule, spore.

steps.en: The gametophyte and everything it makes are haploid: protonema (n), antherozoid (n).
Fertilisation gives a diploid zygote (2n), which grows into the sporophyte, so the capsule is 2n.
Meiosis in the capsule gives haploid spores (n).

answer.en: Protonema n, antherozoid n, zygote 2n, capsule 2n, spore n
